_doc: Generated-only replacement placement spec. Heading anchors were retained from the original reviewed placement file.

figures.alt: Cabinet door and drawer fronts staged on a clean painting workbench
figures.caption: Remove and label doors, drawers, and hardware before coating. A controlled staging area makes surface prep and reinstallation more reliable than painting around hinges.

figures.alt: Kitchen base cabinet run checked level before countertop installation
figures.caption: Correct loose boxes, uneven faces, and damaged edges before paint. Coating can improve a sound cabinet finish, but it cannot straighten a poorly supported installation.

figures.alt: Kitchen wall prepared for backsplash tile beside installed cabinets
figures.caption: Protect counters, floors, and adjacent finishes while the coatings cure. Kitchen projects overlap, so schedule painting around tile, plumbing, and hardware work rather than rushing the finish.
